comment: Took him for 121 and 221. He is hilarious, gives you a study guide for the exams. lais 221 is just so hard and annoying

dr corradini is by far the best prof i have taken at ur so far, i was nervous for lais121 but he made the class so enjoyable and i always looked forward to coming to class everyday! he is so funny and the class was always laughing during his lectures and exams are pretty easy. if you have to take lais121 or lais221, i cannot recommend him enough!

I took Corrado for 151 and then abroad in Spain as well. By far best prof I have had in my life. Best guy all around and truly cares about his students. He is super funny and knows how to teach in a not-boring way. The class itself at the end of the day requires a good bit of homework, but its extremely doable and all online.

The FYS "Island of Tears" requires a lot of work - Watching ~18 movies & reading two heavy textbooks w/ supplemental readings, quizzes & a final exam, which are challenging. Dr. Corradini is passionate about Italian American history. He told some interesting stories in class, but his feedback was tardy and he sometimes didn't go over the readings.

Dr. Corradini's The Families FYS was engaging and you could tell he is passionate about the content. The movies and textbook reading were time-consuming and definitely necessary to participate in class discussions. Overall, he made the content interesting and connected it to global and historical contexts in an interesting way.

The Families is a very interesting FYS made better by the fact that Dr Corradini is an amazing professor. There is a lot of homework (movies and readings before every class) and daily quizzes on it, which is tough. But overall the class is enjoyable.

Prof Corradini is an absolutely amazing professor. He makes each class fun and he has a great sense of humor. He assigns a reasonable amount of homework and his quizzes and tests are always fair. He is accessible outside of class and will do his best to help you in any way he can. I highly recommend taking him!

He comes off super intimidating, but after a couple weeks he starts to come out of his shell. There is VHL every night and you have to teach it to yourself for the hw. It's tedious, but manageable. There are mini quizzes and writings every week too. He's big on participation, and will call you out for slacking. But he'll help you if you're working!

Professor Corradini is probably the best Spanish teacher I've ever had. Coming into the class, I was worried I wouldn't be able to keep up. But, Professor Corradini makes every class enjoyable and really makes you learn the language. He also has a great sense of humor!
Great teacher and very funny and entertaining

I love Corrado. He is super friendly, funny, and a great teacher. He lived in Spain for years and grew up in Italy so his Spanish is excellent and he has funny stories about Europe. The intensive course is a lot of homework but since it's two units, it isn't bad at all. I would highly recommend Corrado.

Had him for two classes. Funniest professor at UR and is very understanding. He is probably my favorite professor if not the top two. For tests they were fair and he would not trick you. He is accessible and always want to help. Corrado is the best and every class, even at 9am you will have some energy to smile at his jokes.
He is so nice and helpful and he is always willing to solve your problems.
Laid back professor who made Spanish fun. Extremely patient and caring. He is also very funny. One of my absolute favorite professors at UR.
Super awesome, super nice, great professor
Is easily confused about what we are doing / what chapter we did for homework, which makes tests confusing because youre not sure what you actually "covered"
explains things well in class. tests are fair. lots of quizzes.

Amazing professor. LAIS151 is meant for those who took Spanish before. It's an easy class if you remember your previous Spanish. It's a bit rougher if you forgot everything or only took 1 year. But he made it easy. Respect him and he respects you. The class is entirely manageable and he made it exemplary.

I have learned more in this class than the four years of Spanish I took in high school. He is hilarious so it makes class entertaining. He does call on you randomly, but this forces you to participate, which actually helps you learn. He is understanding and helpful and isn't a tough grader. I would highly recommend taking him, wish I could for 221!

Dr. Corradini is an amazing teacher! He's funny and has good stories too. As long as you keep up with the homework, review your vocabulary, and participate in class, you'll do absolutely fine. This class is easy to get an A in; you just have to put in the effort.
I absolutely loved Corradini's class. He is incredibly friendly, helpful and funny--made everyday class bearable. Many others in my class disliked him, but only because they had to actually do work.

He's awesome! My favorite professor for my first semester of college. He was always willing to help and go the extra mile for his students. Even though this was the intensive level, it was relatively easy if you did the assignments and had taken spanish classes before (I had 4 years in high school). He's very sweet and funny, as well.
